benin-2016.notes: Source 1 is a whole-host crawl of a company site; the page naming this contest is commented out in the page source and the crawl holds no Beninese 2016 results or problems. The earlier reader confirmed it as web (medium); I kept confirm at medium, a human may prefer to drop it. Crawl also holds the Togolese 2016 problem set and report (a different contest, not this one). Source 3 has no copy.
